commits.headline: Fix display cache not refreshing after streaming completes
commits.body:

.onChange(of: messages.count), but streaming updates message content
without changing the count. This caused text responses to not appear
after streaming even though the content was saved to Core Data.

- Unit tests for should_summarize_content helper
- Unit tests for summarize_content function
